cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; A secluded river bathing pavilion with sunlit limestone steps and a wicker basket for towels — She sets her folded swimming robe on a warm ledge before checking the water temperature with her toes; a training gym with a heavy bag — standing; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — seated on a chair; A bamboo-slip conservation studio with shallow sorting trays — She matches a broken half of a wooden tally to its mate before tying the two halves together for storage; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — adjusts the height of the stand holding a microphone; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a wind-rippled desert dune trail — lying on her left side; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a starship galley and mess hall — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; her bedroom — holds a wedge of watermelon out toward the camera; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height
